Method of Attack: Obfuscation technique using Unicode to evade detection while stealing and exfiltrating developers' account credentials and other sensitive data from compromised devices
Attack Vector: Utilizes a mix of Unicode characters to bypass automated scans and defenses based on string matching. This obfuscation makes the package appear innocuous while performing malicious behaviors such as stealing sensitive data and authentication tokens from developers
Indicators of Compromise: The package uses identifiers like '__import__', 'subprocess', and 'CryptUnprotectData' which have a vast number of variants in Unicode, easily evading string-matching-based defenses
